points.description: The student explains that tears help wash away or remove the dust particles from the eye to prevent damage.

rubric.notes: Full marks are awarded if the student mentions that tears flush out the dust particles. No marks are awarded if the answer does not link the production of tears to the removal of the dust.
rubric.answer_key: डोळ्यात गेलेले धुळीचे कण अश्रूंसोबत वाहून बाहेर काढले जातात, ज्यामुळे डोळ्यांचे नुकसान टाळता येते.
